change_from_v1: If the independently registered dev interval-calibration grid selects a shrink factor below 1, apply that exact factor to valid model intervals during automatic test inference composition. All other v1 rules remain unchanged.
invalid_window_fallback: centered 80 percent of that window, not shrunk
spatial_base: previously validated Qwen3-VL LoRA reader predictions
missing_spatial_frame: nearest existing old prediction within the same video
local_validation: 174 videos, no duplicate or out-of-range frames, no invalid boxes
